title: Attorney general; aid in enforcement.
bodyText: Upon written request of the department, the attorney general shall prosecute all violations on behalf of the department for the enforcement of the provisions of this chapter.
bodyHtml: §271-37  Attorney general; aid in enforcement.  Upon written request of the department, the attorney general shall prosecute all violations on behalf of the department for the enforcement of the provisions of this chapter. [L 1978, c 66, §6; am L 2024, c 117, §4]
